verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Canva's APIs, SDKs, MCP server, and admin/integration tooling, but contains no mention of responsive frames, auto layout, constraints, or grid-based resizing behavior akin to real UI flex layouts within the design editor itself. Design resizing mentioned (canva-docs-6, canva-docs-16) refers to static output resizing to new fixed dimensions, not dynamic responsive layout behavior.
